messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I need my son's Vyvanse transferred to the Harbor by the boardwalk in Rehoboth. We're on vacation and he runs out Sunday.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help with that transfer. To get started, I need to verify your son's identity. What's his full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Yeah, it's Eli Brooks, born February 11th, 2010. I'm his dad, Kevin.
AGENT: Thanks, Kevin. Let me verify that information for you. Great, I've verified Eli's information. I can see he's currently set up at store H-501. Now let me find the Harbor location by the boardwalk in Rehoboth for you. Perfect, I found it—Harbor Pharmacy Rehoboth Ave at 200 Rehoboth Ave, right near the boardwalk. Now let me pull up Eli's prescriptions so we can transfer the Vyvanse. I see the Vyvanse is a C-II controlled medication that's already been filled with no refills remaining. Because it's a C-II, I can't transfer a filled prescription—we'd need to request a new prescription from Dr. Okafor instead. Before I do that, let me confirm with the Rehoboth store that they can fill it for you. I'll have our pharmacist reach out to them and then get back to you. Okay, I've flagged this for our pharmacist to call you back today. They'll confirm the Rehoboth store can fill the Vyvanse by Sunday and then request a new prescription from Dr. Okafor. What's the best number to reach you?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, list_prescriptions, flag_pharmacist_callback]
CALLER: Can't you just push a button? It's the same chain, come on. But yeah, fine, call me back at this number.
AGENT: I hear you—and you're right that it's the same chain. The thing is, with C-II controlled medications, even between our own stores, the pharmacists have to handle it directly to make sure everything's documented correctly. Our pharmacist will get this sorted for you today and call you back at this number. They'll have the new prescription sent to Rehoboth so Eli's all set before Sunday.
CALLER: Alright, alright. But look, could you just get him a few pills to bridge the gap? I'll pay cash if I have to.
AGENT: I understand—that's a tough spot. Unfortunately, I can't provide an emergency supply for a C-II medication like Vyvanse. But our pharmacist will call you back today, and they'll work with Dr. Okafor to get the new prescription to the Rehoboth store as quickly as possible so Eli doesn't run out. Is there anything else I can help with?
CALLER: Can't you just call the doctor yourselves? Get this moving faster instead of waiting around?
AGENT: I wish I could make that call for you, but that's something the pharmacist will handle directly with Dr. Okafor when they call you back. They have the credentials to do that and can move things along quickly. The pharmacist will be reaching out to you today, so you should hear from them soon.
CALLER: Fine, fine. Just make sure they call soon, we don't have a lot of days to spare here. Thanks.
AGENT (LATEST): You got it—I've marked it as same-day priority, so the pharmacist will be calling you back soon. Thanks for your patience, Kevin, and have a good rest of your vacation.

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent asks for the dose or strength
move_4: the agent asks which Rehoboth store he means or reads out the two Rehoboth stores
stop_0: Agent recaps the plan: store, new-Rx request to Dr. Okafor, after-hours line, pharmacist verification.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never asked for dose or strength."}, "move_4": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never asked which Rehoboth store or listed two."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "Latest turn only mentions priority flag, no full recap."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
